description: Paid (0.01 USDC per call). One day's fixing for a ticker: median USD per GPU-hour of eligible quotes, with low, high and count. Quote segments (MKT, AGG, NEO, INT, EXE, HYP) fix from that day's snapshots; the default day is the latest snapshot. SPOT fixes from the full UTC day of spot events, so the default is yesterday; SPOT composites carry per-region values and spread_vs_neo. See /methodology for eligibility and aggregation.

day.description: Fixing day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: latest available.

ticker.description: Ticker from /index/tickers, e.g. `CX.H100SXM.NEO` or `CX.H100SXM.SPOT.US-EAST-1`. Example: CX.H100SXM.NEO

name: index_fixing

spread_vs_neo.description: SPOT composite minus the latest NEO fixing.

value.description: Median USD per GPU-hour of eligible quotes (or median across regions for SPOT composites).

title: Index fixing
